What do a top-of-the-line mountain bike, an artificial hip joint, and a smartphone have in common? We develop the software used to manufacture these high-end products! With hyperMILL®, we control CNC machines and set the highest standards for performance and part quality.
We are one of the world’s leading developers of high-performance CAD/CAM solutions—and have been for more than 30 years! Our innovative CAD/CAM technologies deliver significantly higher performance in the programming process and set international standards in machining.
We are looking to expand our development team at our Headquarter in Wessling near Munich, with a focus on C++-based algorithm development and the further development of our software architecture.
Your main tasks
Design, development, and optimization of mathematical algorithms in C++ for generating highly precise and efficient toolpaths

s.t: Shared responsibility for the further development of our software architecture to improve scalability

Contributing your own ideas, experiences, and perspectives to proactively participate in the development of future hyperMILL® modules
Your profile

s.h: Successful completion of a degree program
s.t: Degree in mathematics, physics, mechanical engineering, computer science, or a comparable technical or scientific field
Comprehensive expertise in development with C++ and an understanding of modern software architecture; experience with C to understand legacy code is a plus
Practical experience in developing technical software solutions, ideally in the field of CAD/CAM systems, CNC technologies, or industrial control systems

s.h: Interest in mathematical and software architecture challenges
s.t: Enjoyment of solving mathematical problems—for example, in the fields of differential geometry or computer geometry—as well as further developing our software architecture

Very good English skills for communication within our international team; knowledge of German is a plus

The United States Space Force (USSF) Space Systems Command (SSC) Space Launch Delta 45 (SLD 45) 1st Space Launch Squadron (1 SLS) at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Florida is searching for a Senior Security Architect (NH-1550-03, GS 12/13 equivalent).

Description: Space Launch Delta 45 is seeking a dynamic Senior Security Architect to join the Range Management Digital Capabilities team and directly advance the operational readiness of our national space launch ranges.

Serving as the premier technical authority, you will lead the organization's strategic shift from reactive compliance to a proactive, resilient, and secure-by-design posture by applying the theoretical foundations of computer science to architect and integrate Zero Trust security models across highly complex mission systems.

In this critical role, you will act as the primary technical liaison with the 645th Cyber Squadron (645 CYS), spearheading the seamless integration of Defensive Cyber Operations (DCO), network monitoring, and advanced security tools directly into the capability development lifecycle.

By conducting advanced threat modeling and translating complex risk analyses into actionable architectural modifications, you will ensure the spaceport's digital infrastructure remains continuously optimized for both maximum security and uncompromised mission effectiveness.

The ideal candidate is a highly technical professional holding a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science-or a related discipline aligned with the 1550 occupational series-complemented by the appropriate cybersecurity certifications required for this critical role.

You bring a proven track record of designing, evaluating, and implementing Zero Trust security solutions across large-scale, diverse networks and complex cloud computing environments.

Armed with a deep understanding of DoW cybersecurity policies and the Risk Management Framework (RMF), you possess hands-on experience seamlessly integrating defensive cyber capabilities, security tools, and network monitoring into operational environments.

Your technical expertise is showcased through your ability to conduct rigorous risk assessments, map complex attack vectors, and engineer robust mitigation strategies directly during system design.

Ultimately, candidates will stand out if they bring highly desired experience partnering directly with cyber defense teams or possess a background in securing space launch infrastructure and range mission systems. Key Skills and Abilities: 1.

Mastery of the theoretical foundations of computer science, including algorithms, computational theory, and computer systems architecture, to design highly complex, secure mission system environments. 2.

Expertise in security tool integration, secure system methodologies, and the design and implementation of defensive cyber capabilities (e.g., network taps, intrusion detection architectures). 3. Advanced skill in architecting and implementing Zero Trust security models across diverse, large-scale, and mission-critical networks and systems. 4.

Knowledge of advanced threat modeling, computational risk analysis, and the ability to simulate and mitigate cyber threats during the earliest phases of the systems development lifecycle. 5.

Ability to evaluate new and emerging computer science technologies, cryptographic protocols, and defensive cyber tools for applicability to spaceport operations. 6. Comprehensive knowledge of DoW cybersecurity policies, Risk Management Framework (RMF), and federal security standards, with the ability to build compliance into system architectures. 7.

Skill in communicating highly complex computational and architectural concepts clearly, both orally and in writing, to diverse audiences including senior leadership, technical developers, and external mission partners.
The 1550 series has an individual occupational requirement that must be met and can be viewed here. In addition to the above requirements you can view the experience level requirements here. Please scroll down to the 4th section titled Professional and Scientific Positions.

Exceptional communication and consulting skills, with the ability to present solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Job Title: Director, Enterprise Data & Digital Platform Architecture
Job Location: Durham, North Carolina, United States of America
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Director of Enterprise Data & Digital Platform Architecture to define and lead the architecture vision for next-generation data, analytics, and AI-driven platforms supporting healthcare and life sciences solutions. This leader will be responsible for designing scalable, cloud-native, interoperable, and compliant platforms that enable trusted data foundations, advanced analytics, digital workflows, and emerging AI capabilities.
The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in cloud and data architectures with strong business acumen and the ability to lead large-scale modernization initiatives. They will partner closely with product, engineering, data, business, and compliance stakeholders to establish architectural standards, guide investment decisions, and create reusable platform capabilities that accelerate innovation across a diverse portfolio of products and services.
This role is critical to advancing enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives, enabling data-driven decision making, AI adoption, interoperability, and future-ready platform capabilities while maintaining the highest standards of security, governance, and regulatory compliance.

This role will define and drive architectural strategy across data, cloud, AI/ML, integration, and platform domains , with a strong focus on:
Enterprise-scale data platforms and data products
Cloud-native architecture and platform modernization
AI/ML and agentic application enablement
Metadata, semantic and ontology-driven architectures
Data interoperability and standards-based integration
Governance, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance
Reusable services, APIs, and platform capabilities
The Director will lead architectural planning and technology roadmaps that support scalable, reusable, and future-ready digital ecosystems. The role requires collaboration across multiple product and engineering teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards and strategic business objectives.
Essential Functions
Architecture Strategy & Technology Roadmap: Develop and maintain the long-term architecture vision, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps that support data, analytics, AI, and digital platform initiatives across the organization.
Enterprise Data Architecture: Define scalable data architecture patterns including data products, master data management, metadata management, semantic layers, ontology frameworks, and governed data foundations that enable enterprise-wide data reuse and interoperability.
AI & Intelligent Platform Enablement: Establish architectural patterns that support AI/ML, generative AI, agentic workflows, knowledge services, and advanced analytics while ensuring governance, traceability, and regulatory compliance.
Platform Modernization: Lead modernization efforts utilizing cloud-native technologies, event-driven architectures, microservices, APIs, and modern data platforms such as Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, and emerging cloud services.
Interoperability & Integration: Drive standards-based integration strategies leveraging healthcare and industry standards such as FHIR, HL7, CDISC, APIs, and event-driven frameworks to enable seamless data exchange across internal and external ecosystems.
Design Governance & Architecture Standards: Establish architecture principles, design review processes, technology standards, reusable patterns, and architectural guardrails that promote consistency, security, and scalability across products and platforms.
Strategic Program Leadership: Provide architectural leadership across major transformation programs and strategic investments, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities and long-term technology strategy.
Emerging Technologies & Innovation: Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends in AI, data management, digital health, interoperability, cloud computing, and platform engineering; recommend adoption strategies where appropriate.
Organizational Leadership & Mentoring: Mentor architects and senior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline (Master's preferred)
12+ years of experience in architecture, engineering leadership, or enterprise technology roles, including leadership of large-scale platform or digital transformation initiatives
Proven experience designing and governing enterprise-scale cloud and data architectures
Deep expertise in cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Kubernetes, API-first architectures, event-driven platforms, and modern integration patterns
Strong knowledge of data management disciplines including data governance, metadata management, master data management, semantic models, and data products
Experience architecting AI/ML, advanced analytics, or intelligent automation solutions in regulated environments
Strong understanding of life sciences, healthcare, or other regulated industries, including standards such as HIPAA, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, FHIR, HL7, and CDISC
Demonstrated success leading enterprise modernization, cloud migration, or platform transformation programs
Excellent communication, executive presence, and stakeholder management skills
Ability to influence strategic decisions and drive alignment across business, product, engineering, and technology organizations

We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position. Job Summary: We are seeking a ServiceNow Architect to lead the design, governance, and long-term evolution of our ServiceNow platform across ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps, and custom applications.

The role combines deep platform mastery with enterprise architecture judgment, driving standards for data, integration, security, and customization that keep the platform scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business priorities.

The ideal candidate has architected ServiceNow at enterprise scale, can confidently shape multi-year roadmaps, and brings strong influence across engineering, business, and executive stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Define ServiceNow platform architecture spanning ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps, GRC, and custom application domains.

Lead architecture reviews, design approvals, and governance for changes across ServiceNow modules. Establish standards for data model usage, custom-table creation, scoped applications, and CMDB design. Drive CMDB strategy including discovery, service mapping, identification rules, and data quality programs.

Architect integrations with enterprise systems via IntegrationHub, MID Servers, REST/SOAP APIs, and event-driven patterns. Design platform-wide security, role models, and ACL strategies that balance functionality with least-privilege principles.

Lead major platform upgrades, release management cycles, and platform health initiatives, planning safe rollouts, coordinating across teams, and driving improvements that keep the platform stable and current over time. Establish reusable patterns for workflow design, Flow Designer adoption, and minimization of unnecessary customization.

Drive performance, scalability, and instance-health improvements across the platform, using telemetry and load patterns to identify bottlenecks, prioritize the most impactful changes, and validate outcomes empirically. Partner with business stakeholders to translate process needs into ServiceNow capabilities with appropriate trade-offs.

Mentor developers, admins, and tech leads on ServiceNow best practices. Coordinate with security and compliance teams to ensure the platform meets regulatory obligations.

Produce high-quality architecture artifacts — context diagrams, sequence diagrams, decision records, and reference designs — that capture key technical decisions clearly enough to be understood months or years later. Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap, Now Assist / AI features, and broader platform evolution.

Required Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Eight or more years of ServiceNow experience, with significant time in architecture or technical leadership roles. Deep expertise across multiple ServiceNow modules.

Strong understanding of the ServiceNow data model, scripting, scoped apps, and platform internals. Hands-on experience with IntegrationHub, REST APIs, and complex integration scenarios. Experience designing CMDB, discovery, and service mapping implementations. Strong understanding of platform security, ACLs, and role design at scale.

Experience leading major upgrades and release planning. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. ServiceNow CTA, CIS, or CSA certifications. Preferred Qualifications ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) credential. Experience with Now Assist, GenAI Controller, or AI-driven ServiceNow features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200 colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles.

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Information Systems Architect to define the best practice in infrastructure as code at a global scale. Join us to advance the state of the art, and shape the infrastructure behind tens of millions devices running Ubuntu.
The Information Systems (IS) team is responsible for all IT operations at Canonical, including the infrastructure for building, packaging and distributing Ubuntu globally. As the IS architect, you will own the design of hardware and software implementation from PCI lanes to CDN and everything in between.

Our goal is to be a reference operation, using the latest capabilities in Ubuntu and open source more generally, with the most modern operating principles. Your choices will impact the Ubuntu user experience for millions of users, and drive how Canonical’s engineers engage with compute and network resources in a devops setting.
As the IS Architect, you’ll be in a unique position to improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they’re based on. You do this by leading System Reliability Engineers (SRE) and Data Center Engineers (DCE) to embrace best practices, and make informed decisions on technology choices in all aspects of cloud infrastructure and services. You will coach the IS team on automation, reliability, operational/technical scalability, network infrastructure and security.
This is a home based position, with twice-annual travel to company events totaling around 4 weeks per year.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region

Define, get buy-in and implement the holistic vision of a world class internal cloud
Setup, maintain and update the technical design roadmap and guidelines for the SREs within IS, with the aim of improving reliability, resilience, operational scalability, and technical scalability
Collaborate with, and provide the cloud-ops software development teams with input for roadmap, requirements and prioritization to build a world-class, highly standardized and automated operation
Provide the IS management with input and advice with regards to technology, reliability, resilience and business cases
Lead technical choices to implement solutions as self-service products, ensuring scalable operation
Collaborate with product security as well as operations security to set best practice and mitigate new threats in a timely manner
Automate operations for reuse across the world's largest companies, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
Collaborate with development teams to design service architecture, documentation, playbooks, policies and operational procedures
Analyze incidents and events, and establish what the reason behind the reasons are, and what structural improvements can be made to minimize the chance of them reoccurring

Are you excited about machine learning, technical architecture, and building the intelligent systems powering the future of sports entertainment?
At Beyond Sports, we don’t just visualize sports — we reinvent how fans experience them. Together with partners like NFL, NHL, FIFA, and Disney, we push the boundaries of real-time sports data, 3D graphics, and AI-driven storytelling.

s.h: What Your Day Will Look Like

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016.

Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like.

OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale.

Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
The Challenge
We are looking for a Senior Technical Architect (Privacy) to join our Technical Advisory team (part of Customer Success). This is a customer-facing role for someone who combines a strong technical foundation with attention to details, and the ability to build trust with customers.
You will work with privacy, legal, compliance, and technology stakeholders to understand business objectives and challenges, assess maturity and platform adoption, and provide clear recommendations across privacy processes, operating models, workflows, data, and integrations. You will act as a trusted advisor and product expert without owning hands-on implementation or configuration.
Previous privacy or OneTrust expertise is valuable, but it is not the defining requirement for this role. We are looking for someone with the attitude, consultancy skills, and technical capability to learn the privacy domain quickly and become a trusted advisor.

Lead outcome-focused discovery, advisory engagements, workshops, and expert sessions with customers.

Create clear, decision-ready deliverables such as current-state assessments, future-state recommendations, reference architectures, process guidance, and reusable patterns.
Build trusted relationships and communicate confidently with both technical and executive audiences.
Partner closely with Customer Success, Product, Sales, Support, Professional Services, and other specialist teams to deliver consistent customer outcomes.
Capture recurring customer needs and translate them into feedback, enablement content, playbooks, and product opportunities.
Maintain clear advisory boundaries: provide strategic framing, product expertise, and guidance while enabling customers or delivery partners to execute implementation.

About Zelara
Most CRM marketing still blasts generic messages at scale and calls it "personalization." Our founders experienced this firsthand in senior roles at HelloFresh, Salesforce, Uber, and others. Backed by top-tier VCs, they decided to build a better way.
Zelara is an agentic lifecycle marketing platform that improves with every interaction. It works with the CRM infrastructure our customers already use, replacing static journeys and manual segmentation with a system that creates content, makes individual-level decisions, and learns from every outcome.
With bunq, Europe's second-largest neobank, we delivered +7.4% activation and +66% reactivation uplift , measured against a control group. We raised a €3M pre-seed and are generating revenue with paying enterprise customers. Now we are hiring our first Solutions Architect to make the path from integration to measurable value repeatable.

This is a deeply technical customer role centered on post-sales value realization, with involvement in pre-sales discovery. It is not conventional customer success built around reactive support and business reviews, nor a pre-sales role that hands off at signature.
You will own technical value realization for a portfolio of customers, from discovery and onboarding through live experiments, measured results, and scaled adoption.
You and the commercial lead run each account as a pair, in a weekly rhythm and in the room together for the conversations that decide something. They own pricing, proposals, contracts, conversion to an annual contract, expansion, and renewal. You own the technical plan and evidence behind those decisions.

Before signature, you lead technical discovery alongside them. After signature, you become the customer's named technical lead, accountable for solution design, data mapping, the experiment plan, stakeholder coordination, and go-live. You make value real and defensible; the commercial lead owns the close.
There is no separate customer success manager, and we are not planning one. The two of you hold the whole relationship: the commercial lead is the account owner, you are the technical owner, and the working relationship with the customer's CRM, data, and analytics teams is yours.
Your focus is the customer-specific application of Zelara's platform. Product owns the roadmap and prioritization. Engineering owns production software, reusable integrations, reliability, and security. Science owns the learning methods and models, experimental methodology, and causal measurement standards. You turn their work into a functioning customer solution and bring in each team when a requirement crosses those boundaries.
Today our founders lead the technical side of every customer relationship. You will take over that responsibility and build the function as the customer base grows.
You will work with mid-market and enterprise B2C companies across Europe: fintech, e-commerce, travel, and employee benefits. Successful pilots grow into long-term, scaled deployments.

Own the technical customer journey from discovery through onboarding, pilot delivery, measured value, and scaled adoption
Lead technical discovery before signature: understand how the customer makes money and which metric moves it, then validate the integration path, available data, measurement feasibility, and what the pilot can credibly promise
Own onboarding: align stakeholders, define the data mapping and acceptance criteria, coordinate implementation, and take the customer live on its existing CRM stack
Design and pre-register each customer experiment using Zelara's scientific standards: hypothesis, primary metric, cohort, control group, conversion window, success threshold, and decision rules, because a success bar set after seeing the data is not a result
Own the customer-facing interpretation of results: reconcile Zelara's analysis with the customer's data, involve Science in novel or ambiguous analyses, and state clearly when the evidence is not decision-ready
Enable the customer's team to operate campaigns independently rather than becoming the person who runs them
Partner with the commercial lead on annual contracts, expansion, and renewal: identify the opportunity, quantify the value, and de-risk the technical plan
Drive the product loop rather than report into it: turn recurring customer needs into product opportunities, engineering requirements, and research questions, and bring the evidence from live accounts that decides their priority
Build what closes the gap in the meantime: use agents to produce the scripts, tooling, and prototypes that unblock an account before the platform covers it

Our goal is ambitious: accelerate scientific progress from R&D through translation by an order of magnitude. Design and lead cohort-based accelerators to scale our expertise and impact across multiple institutions at once.

Build and maintain high level dashboards that allows both operations and leadership teams to track KPI.
